oclif probe

USAGE
  $ probe deploy [TARGET] [-f] [-n <value>] [--dry-run] [-o <value>]
    [--color]

ARGUMENTS
  [TARGET]  deploy target

FLAGS
  -f, --force           skip confirmation prompts
  -n, --limit=<value>   maximum number of results to return, a deliberately long
                        description so oclif has to wrap it onto continuation
                        lines
  -o, --output=<value>  write output here
      --[no-]color      colorize
      --dry-run         print what would change

DESCRIPTION
  oclif probe
